item.title: Women in Football: The leaders pioneering the future of the game
item.description: Over a decade ago, female role models in football – a sport long dominated by men – were virtually unheard of. Today, not only has the gender divide continued to narrow, but a growing cohort of women are now leading the way in senior positions across the EFL. Once excluded from the boardroom, women today hold more than just a seat at the table, many are now the driving force. item.title: Pompey in the Community inspire next generation on International Women’s Day
item.description: The EFL is celebrating International Women’s Day by highlighting the impact of community football programmes across the country. At a recent camp hosted by Pompey in the Community, 150 girls took part in a session designed to develop their skills, build confidence and encourage participation in the women’s and girls’ game. item.description: Grimsby Town held Bromley to a 1–1 draw at Blundell Park, extending the Sky Bet League Two leaders’ run to five draws in their last six games. Bromley took the lead in the 28th minute when Nicke Kabamba capitalised on a defensive mix-up to score into an empty net. item.description: Lincoln City moved to the summit of Sky Bet League One with a 2-0 win over Cardiff City in top of the table chash at the Cardiff City Stadium. Rob Street opened the scoring before Dom Jefferies doubled the lead late on to stretch their unbeaten league run to 18 matches. item.title: Port Vale stun Sunderland to reach FA Cup Quarter-Finals
item.description: Port Vale produced one of the shocks of the season as the Sky Bet League One side defeated Premier League Sunderland to book their place in the Emirates FA Cup Quarter-Finals. It marks the first time since 1954 that Vale have reached the last eight, despite currently sitting bottom of the third tier. item.description: AFC Wimbledon moved further clear of the Sky Bet League One relegation battle as Callum Maycock’s early goal sealed a narrow victory over Northampton Town at Plough Lane.
